# B1 + B2 tables (generated by b1_b2_analyse.py)

Unit test (22 molecules): B3LYP frequencies from the fchk Hessian agree with Gaussian's log to 0.000 cm-1; intensities from APT x modes to 0.005 % (relative to max(I, 1 km/mol)).
